title: Customer Onboarding for Remote Cheque Deposit (RCD) Feature
description: Retail banking customers must complete a one-time enrollment to activate the Remote Cheque Deposit feature on their mobile app. Enrollment requires the customer to accept the RCD Terms and Conditions, confirm their eligible account (current or savings), and pass an identity re-verification step using biometric (fingerprint/face ID) or OTP sent to the registered mobile number. Only customers with accounts older than 90 days and no active fraud flags are eligible.
acceptance_criteria: Customer sees RCD enrollment prompt on first navigation to Deposit section; Eligibility check runs silently before showing enrollment — ineligible customers see explanation message; Terms and Conditions displayed in full with scroll-to-bottom requirement before Accept button activates; Biometric re-verification attempted first — falls back to OTP if biometric unavailable; OTP delivered within 60 seconds to registered mobile number; Accounts less than 90 days old shown specific ineligibility reason; Customers with active fraud flags shown generic ineligibility message without disclosing fraud flag; Successful enrollment confirmation shown with daily and per-cheque deposit limits; Enrollment status persisted — re-verification not required on subsequent sessions
